Crazy Rich Asians TV Series in Development with Original Cast

A television series based on the film 'Crazy Rich Asians' is in development eight years after the movie's release. The series is set to feature original cast members, including Michelle Yeoh, Henry Golding, Ronny Chieng, and Constance Wu. The project is being developed by HBO.
